name: Moog Matriarch
description: Moog Matriarch semi-modular analog synthesizer: the MIDI CC mapping of its manual, and its global settings by SysEx, read back one at a time.

sources.title: Matriarch Manual (01/2023)
sources.notes: MIDI CC table (pages 74, 75) and MIDI CC table (pages 76, 77, 78, 79) read by tools/profiles/moog/read-moog-pdf.mjs from Matriarch_Manual_012023.pdf (sha256 66f64a5de7cdd5d6114e46d09000f2fe8546dc12dee31126cd2de7fa880ad188), https://cdn.inmusicbrands.com/Moog/Matriarch/Matriarch_Manual_012023.pdf. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/moog/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/moog/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the manual's MIDI tables, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
No identity check: the manual prints no Device Inquiry reply.
The SysEx messages go to Unit ID 7F, which the manual says addresses any Unit ID; set the unitId variable to address one Matriarch among several.
A global setting is read back by asking for it alone: the Matriarch answers with its set message, the byte before the Unit ID set to 1 so that it is not taken for a command if echoed back.
74 global setting(s) are read back one at a time: each request asks for one parameter, and the instrument answers with that parameter's set message, marked as a reply.

12 knob(s) are 14-bit, 0 - 16383: the MSB and the LSB the table prints, sent in that order: Mod Wheel (CC 1, LSB 33); Mod Rate (CC 3, LSB 35); Glide Time (CC 5, LSB 37); Arp Rate (CC 8, LSB 40); Noise Filter Cutoff (CC 9, LSB 41); Delay Time (CC 12, LSB 44); Delay Spacing (CC 13, LSB 45); Arp Swing (CC 14, LSB 46); Arp Gate Length (CC 15, LSB 47); Osc 2 Frequency (CC 16, LSB 48); Osc 3 Frequency (CC 17, LSB 49); Osc 4 Frequency (CC 18, LSB 50).
Left out, a note number to tie to, not a setting: Portamento Control (CC 84).
Left out, the Unit ID every one of these messages is addressed by: Unit ID (parameter 0).

coverage.editBufferDumpRequest: partial: a request per global setting
coverage.editBufferDumpParse: partial: the global settings, one reply each
coverage.inboundControllers: the panel sends these same messages when its MIDI settings allow

parameters.name: MIDI Channel IN
parameters.description: Parameter 10, set by SysEx. Printed: 0-15 = MIDI Channel 1-16 (Default: 0 / MIDI Channel 1).

parameters.name: MIDI Channel OUT
parameters.description: Parameter 11, set by SysEx. Printed: 0-15 = MIDI Channel 1-16 (Default: 0 / MIDI Channel 1).

parameters.name: Arp/Seq Swing
parameters.description: Parameter 23, set by SysEx. Printed: 0-16383 = 0 to 100% (Default: 8192 = 50% / no swing).

parameters.name: Keyboard Octave Transpose
parameters.description: Parameter 38, set by SysEx. Printed: 0-4 = -2 to +2 (Default: 2 / no transpose).

parameters.description: Parameter 43, set by SysEx. Printed: 0-24 Semitones (Default: 7).

parameters.name: Pitch Variance
